source_evidence.label: OPH scoring process
source_evidence.claim: Experts trained by SOLKI assess separate speaking result; no evidence that generated machine score is official.

source_evidence.label: JYU published spoken assessment criteria page 2
source_evidence.claim: Holistic levels 3 and 4; fluency, flexibility, coherence, lexical specificity, pronunciation intelligibility, grammar.

source_evidence.label: JYU SOLKI general YKI task description
source_evidence.claim: Historically speaking uses studio-recorded replies to simulated dialogue, reaction, narrative and questions; not a verified 2027 digital control.

source_evidence.label: SOLKI intermediate speaking examples
source_evidence.claim: Four exemplar families including kertominen/keskustelu/tilanteita/mielipide, timing applies only to historical examples.

source_evidence.label: OPH November digital pilot
source_evidence.claim: Finnish intermediate computer pilot planned 2026-11-07, no confirmed digital mic phases/audio UI.

source_evidence.label: Wang & Min 2026 automated speaking agreement
source_evidence.claim: Meta 67 studies/392 effects, r=.654 overall human-machine correlation; no absolute official YKI agreement or cutoffs.

source_evidence.label: ASR pronunciation pedagogy 2023
source_evidence.claim: 15-study English learning meta reports g=.69 pronunciation gains; not Finnish speaking ability or official level prediction.

source_evidence.label: Towards inclusive ASR 2024
source_evidence.claim: Accent, age and other speaker characteristics can change ASR recognition bias; depends on language and architecture.

source_evidence.label: Nelson & Cardoso 2025 English L2 age bias
source_evidence.claim: 1000 English test responses, three ASR systems showed age-related transcription effects; cannot transfer quantitative bias into Finnish.

source_evidence.label: Finnish assessment prototype Hilden et al 2025 (reused R04)
source_evidence.claim: Finnish/Swedish low-resource ASR fluency features are emerging, not proof of official YKI automated scorer.

source_evidence.label: MDN MediaRecorder API
source_evidence.claim: Recording chunks and lifecycle must be handled reliably, not only object URL.

source_evidence.label: MDN getUserMedia
source_evidence.claim: Permission, unsupported device and secure context constraints need explicit fault handling.

live_web_exam_baseline.capture_storage: Only transient Blob/ObjectURL in browser memory, no durable media persisted
live_web_exam_baseline.typed_plan: May substitute for task input, explicitly not scored as speaking
live_web_exam_baseline.voiceRecorded_on_reload: Cleared to {} by loadSession, avoiding false restoration of audio
live_web_exam_baseline.audio_chunks_on_navigation: stopAudio sets onstop=null, cancels async audio creation before navigation

rubric_levels.B1_level3: Generally intelligible, communicative success in everyday situations, errors/hesitation permissible
rubric_levels.B2_level4: More flexible and fluent, coherent, suited register and audience, clearer sustained expression
rubric_levels.meaning: Holistic official rubric, not our numeric arithmetic

design_consequences: Original S2-reviewed narrative, original multi-turn recorded partner dialogue, multi-situation reactions and reasoned opinion as four families, no copyright reuse.
Record true spoken response; typed plan never constitutes audio evidence for YKI speaking readiness.
Microphone preflight before sealing EXAM; separate optional familiarization outside active test.
Prep, cue, answer windows are versioned practice-policy fields until 2027 digital OPH evidence; no fake 60/90 production rule.
Start/stop/bytes/readback/hash/receipt recorded atomically and idempotently before navigation/reveal; no audio or zero bytes means UNGRADED.
During EXAM no ASR live transcript, hints, confetti or correction; after sealed durable finish separate LEARN meaningful self-repair.
Human Finnish S2 rater calibration and adjudication of task goal, intelligibility, fluency, coherence, lexical range, accuracy, register, and pronunciation; no native-accent penalty.
Optional ASR after exam can propose uncertain hypotheses, never official level 3/4 or pronunciation truth.
Original audio and user voice privacy: rights, consent, retention, delete/export and no hidden network upload.
Novel delayed day14/30 spoken responses assessed by blinded human raters and distinct task content.

example_studies.theme: phone reschedule with recorded interlocutor prompts
describe recent challenge, what changed and why
compare public service options with reasons

risks.risk: Voice lost after refresh or navigation: MediaRecorder Blob is only an object URL
risks.mitigation: Persist actual bytes in same logical attempt transaction; verify blob readback, hash, version and receipt before claiming reviewed speaking

risks.risk: Recorder is stopped on navigation but onstop handler is explicitly nulled; final chunks may not be processed
risks.mitigation: Serialize stop->dataavailable->blob finalized->store ack before any navigation/finish; handle 0-byte and stream interrupted

risks.risk: Microphone denied, unavailable, silent, silent-device or unexpected permission changes
risks.mitigation: Preflight permission and playback test, fail clearly without manufacturing speaking success

risks.risk: One short situation and one opinion mini do not exercise narrative + multi-turn dialogue construct
risks.mitigation: Build original S2-reviewed recorded partner-turn and narrative tasks linked to canonical four speaking families

risks.risk: Exact 2027 speaking prep/cues/recording windows/input unknown; archive is legacy studio
risks.mitigation: No official timing/audio UI claims before authorized demo walkthrough and OPH live equivalence confirmation

risks.risk: ASR transcripts/typing plans cannot establish communicative intelligibility or official YKI 3/4
risks.mitigation: Human-calibrated audio review; machine provides qualified formative hints only after finish

risks.risk: Voice data are sensitive personal communication and local storage is clearable
risks.mitigation: Consent and transparent retention; privacy-first local lifecycle, user-managed delete and export, no undeclared remote upload

risks.risk: After submit/expiry, race between async onstop and durable finish receipt
risks.mitigation: Transactional event schema, idempotent stop, no feedback before audio and finish readback

risks.risk: Signal quality and browser incompatibilities can destroy intelligibility
risks.mitigation: Device/browser headset+mic test, codec sniff, silence/clip detection, desktop/mobile failure injection

risks.risk: Pronunciation metrics conflate accent with intelligibility; classifier bias by age/voice/L1
risks.mitigation: Blind Finnish S2 adjudication and subgroup fairness; never gate B1/B2 on native-accent imitation

risks.risk: Spontaneous speaking and pragmatics not measured by word count or recording duration
risks.mitigation: Task-specific communicative success rubric, discourse management, register and follow-up responsiveness

risks.risk: Feedback leaks inside sealed exam and repeats exposed items as 'independent' retest
risks.mitigation: EXAM silent until durable finish, LEARN separate self-correction, novel unseen delayed day14/day30 task bank

gates.description: Source-backed original four family item bank reviewed by two independent S2 teachers
Authorized production voice and interlocutor rights/consent
Durable byte-backed audio capture with readback/hash and idempotent receipts
Mic denial, silence, recorder.stop, codec, reload, background and concurrent-tab browser E2E
No feedback before sealed persistent finish; no typed plan counted as spoken evidence
Independent calibrated Finnish S2 raters with adjudication and no auto-grade substitution
Voice privacy/retention/deletion/export and no undisclosed upload
Verified OPH 2027 mic/cue/prep windows and E2E or practice-only disclaimer
Day 14/30 unseen speaking transfer outcome compared fairly with human blind assessment

rights_policy: Link historical official examples only. New scripts/media must be originally authored and licensed; no transcription or republishing of SOLKI audio.
user_data_policy: User voice is identifiable and potentially sensitive; default device-local handling, no undeclared third-party API, meaningful explicit retention and deletion controls.
